artifact_store: content-addressed filesystem initially; S3-compatible adapter later
graph_representation: directed adjacency relation tables in PostgreSQL
approximate_vector_policy: No approximate index until benchmark justifies it; prefer HNSW first if required and validate recall against exact search.
authority_policy: Relational scientific/source records and content hashes are authoritative; graph convenience views, full-text vectors, embeddings, and vector indexes are rebuildable projections.
demonstrated_workloads: trace synthesis statement to evidence and exact source locator
filter evidence by source fidelity and verification state
support exact-term novelty search and semantic candidate retrieval

rejected_v1_choices.choice: Neo4j or another graph database as co-authority
rejected_v1_choices.reason: Adds duplicate state/synchronization without a demonstrated workload that PostgreSQL adjacency traversal cannot handle.

rejected_v1_choices.choice: vector database as primary knowledge store
rejected_v1_choices.reason: Similarity search cannot represent authoritative provenance, transactional identity, audit history, and typed relation semantics.
Current corpus scale does not justify trading recall for speed before benchmarks.
